summary: Focused Nov 6–7 intake: recorded announced Miller/Wiles transition, Iran sanctions, Senate leadership-delay pressure and Venezuela TPS temporary stay; updated Cook hearing calendar. Major unreviewed outcomes include Los Angeles election grand jury, later immigration rulings and Israeli coalition developments. Remaining election calls and Iran policy decision stay open.

coverage.scope: Targeted calendar screen across ten issues and deeper post-election personnel review since Nov 6. Not a full daily source census or named watch rotation.

Outstanding election calls and certifica.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check the remaining Alaska and Mississippi Senate and Alaska and Kansas governor calls, certification and final margins.

Israel government formation.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check Nov 8 mandate and subsequent coalition commitments.

Cook court filing and hearing.finding: Reuters reports December 14 hearing indication and Nov 6 joint status report; process and participation remain pending.

Iran war decision.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check for a new directive, observable implementation or an accepted agreement.

House leadership and Pentagon job pressu.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check Nov 10 conference votes, Massie floor action, Hegseth job status and Tennessee appointment.

Succession.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Rubio gave a public response. Check endorsements, organization, polling and any confirmed departure.

AI.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check Anthropic rehearing and FTC action, Meta appeal and Nov 15 export-control comments.

Epstein oversight.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Massie predicted 218 signatures. Verify the actual tally, any floor vote, releases and any Maurene Comey appeal filing.

Immigration court decisions.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Verify Nov 6 Venezuela TPS stay disposition and mandate, bond detention and Khalil.

Tariffs.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check Section 301 ruling, Section 338 litigation and Canadian negotiations.

Venezuela.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check OFAC Citgo decision and Nov 11–15 talks.

Russia.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check Abu Dhabi talks, deliveries and Nov 21 Lukoil license expiration.

Election enforcement grand jury.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Search surfaced prior subpoena reporting. The specific Nov 4 Los Angeles outcome remains unverified.

Senate oversight.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Watch for production, subpoenas and committee authority after organization.

Afghan removal order expiration.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check the November 7 expiration, any extension, and any subsequent removal notices.

D.C. Guard implementation and litigation.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Check implementation of expanded patrol authority and status of District litigation.

Chamber control.finding: AP and current election reporting continue to project Democratic control of both chambers in the next Congress; current authority has not transferred.

Israel consultations.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Herzog reported 67 recommendations for Eisenkot and 46 for Netanyahu. Mutual vetoes still constrain government formation.

Iran mediation contact.finding: Carried from Nov 6; not independently resolved this run. Qatar reported the Nov 6 Trump–Tamim call on de-escalation.

Venezuela TPS administrative stay.finding: Read Nov 3 order granting temporary stay; mandate issuance and later disposition remain pending.

Chief of staff.finding: Miller appointment confirmed; Nov 9 handover and political-operation role pending.

Iran sanctions.finding: Eight Canadian businesses designated Nov 6; financial effects unknown.

Iran diplomacy and operations.finding: Axios reports Vance mediation and a Qeshm strike; verify further military orders and any agreement.

Senate leadership timetable.finding: Reported Johnson delay request; no postponement or leadership result verified.
